assertions.rationale: MongoClientConfigurationStore : IClientConfigurationStore implements the interface with all four methods.

assertions.assertion: Includes an AddAsync method for persisting new clients
Includes a FindByClientIdAsync method that returns Client or null
assertions.rationale: FindByClientIdAsync returns Task<Client?> and yields null via FirstOrDefaultAsync when absent.

assertions.assertion: Includes UpdateAsync and DeleteAsync methods for client lifecycle management
assertions.rationale: UpdateAsync (ReplaceOneAsync) and DeleteAsync (DeleteOneAsync) are both implemented.

assertions.assertion: Mentions that client secrets should be stored securely (hashed, not plaintext)
assertions.rationale: Explicitly states to store secrets hashed and never in plaintext, with an example of Sha256 hashing.
